notes.title: Demo Launch Alert!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6V0Loi4-dJ8;full][/previewyoutube]Hi everyone!  

After a lot of feedback, playtesting, bug fixes, and plenty of bullet hell testing, we're finally launching our demo this [b]September 27, 2025[/b]!  
Be one of the first group of friends to play!

[h3]I've played the public playtest. What's new?[/h3]
• Added 40 new sets of obstacles, most of these you can experience in the late game  
• Added 2 new team abilities  
• Added fists, feet, and a few other horrifying things when you take them out of context  
• Game can now be played with one single controller. Just go to lobby and press "START"  
• More details here: https://discord.com/channels/350439842225586176/1073446764146860092/1360886313561231370

So grab your friends, hop on the couch (or use Steam Remote Play), and get ready to scream, laugh, and maybe lose a friendship or two.  
(Kaz will help you along the way 😉)


[h3]Want to be a Beta Tester?[/h3]
We are now recruiting Beta Testers (Haphazard Angel Private Playtesters)!  
Be the first to try out new arcade features and the upcoming Adventure Mode in the next few months.

notes.title: Help us break our game!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]  

The team is incredibly happy to receive a lot of playtest requests even before we announced anything! (also because we didn't know how the steam announcements work). But to start, we'll be opening up 20 playtest keys and our goal is mainly just to bugfix and polish the main game loop. This will be the exact same features you'll see during our demo launch this January - so please keep it a secret! 

For feedback and suggestions, please hop in our discord: https://discord.gg/efQUhZPuc9

[h3]🌟 Why Join the Playtest?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*][b]Get Early Access![/b] Be among the first to try [i]Haphazard Angel[/i].  
[*][b]Team Up With Friends![/b] Control one angel together—chaos (and maybe a few arguments) guaranteed.  
[*][b]Shape the Game![/b] Tell us what you love, what’s busted, and what could be better.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h3]🚨 What’s New Since Last Time?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*][b]🎮 Steam Remote Play[/b] is here—play with friends anywhere!  
[*][b]👥 Co-op Fun[/b] now live for 2+ players.  
[*][b]🛠️ Enhanced Gameplay[/b] with new obstacles, animations, and action feedback.  
[*][b]💥 More BOOMs and POWs[/b] for extra chaotic fun.  
[*][b]🎨 A Fresh Look[/b] with a new loading screen and surprises waiting for you.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h3]✨ How to Join:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com]Wishlist [i]Haphazard Angel[/i] on Steam[/url] (if you haven’t already).  [b]you must.[/b]
[*]Look out for the playtest button on our Steam page!  
[*]Gather your friends, take to the skies, and let the chaos begin.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[b]👼 We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see the havoc you wreak in [i]Haphazard Angel[/i]![/b]  

💬 Have questions? Drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/efQUhZPuc9]Discord server[/url] and let’s chat.  

See you in the skies, Angels!
